info.title: QuizColegio: webapp de gestión de quices

metadata.displayText:
Actúa como arquitecto y desarrollador full-stack senior. Construye desde cero una webapp llamada "QuizColegio": un sistema de gestión y aplicación de quices para un colegio. Trabaja por fases, ejecuta y prueba cada una antes de pasar a la siguiente, y al final entrega un README con instrucciones de instalación y uso. Toda la interfaz debe estar en español.

## 1. Stack
- Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
- Prisma ORM con SQLite en desarrollo (esquema compatible con PostgreSQL para producción)
- Autenticación propia con usuario/contraseña (hash con argon2 o bcrypt), sesiones en cookie httpOnly + SameSite=Strict
- Validación con Zod en todas las entradas del servidor
- Extracción de PDF: pdfjs-dist o pdf-parse (con OCR opcional vía tesseract.js para PDFs escaneados)
- Generación de preguntas con un LLM mediante una capa de abstracción de proveedor (interfaz `LLMProvider`), configurable por variables de entorno (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY u OPENAI_API_KEY). La API key nunca debe llegar al cliente.

## 2. Roles
- Administrador: gestiona usuarios, cursos/grupos y configuración global.
- Docente: crea documentos, quices y revisa resultados de sus grupos.
- Estudiante: presenta los quices asignados a su grupo.

## 3. Flujo de creación del quiz (docente)
1. El docente sube uno o varios PDFs (material de estudio, un examen existente o un banco de preguntas).
2. Elige el modo:
   a) "Generar desde material": el LLM crea preguntas a partir del contenido. El docente indica cantidad, tipos (opción múltiple de una respuesta, selección múltiple, verdadero/falso, respuesta corta), dificultad e idioma.
   b) "Importar examen/banco existente": el sistema detecta las preguntas, opciones y respuestas correctas del PDF y las estructura. Si no detecta la respuesta correcta, la marca como "pendiente de revisión".
3. El LLM debe devolver JSON estricto validado con Zod (enunciado, opciones, respuesta(s) correcta(s), explicación breve, tema, página de origen). Si el JSON es inválido, reintenta hasta 2 veces.
4. Pantalla de revisión: el docente puede editar, eliminar, reordenar y agregar preguntas manualmente antes de publicar. Nada se publica sin revisión.
5. Los documentos largos se procesan por fragmentos (chunking) con una barra de progreso, y se evitan preguntas duplicadas entre fragmentos.

## 4. Parámetros configurables por quiz
- Título, descripción, grupos asignados, ventana de disponibilidad (fecha/hora inicio y fin)
- Navegación: "Solo hacia adelante (sin retroceder)" o "Permitir retroceder y cambiar respuestas"
- Tiempo límite total y/o por pregunta (opcional)
- Aleatorizar orden de preguntas y de opciones (por estudiante)
- Cantidad de intentos permitidos
- Número de preguntas a tomar del banco (subconjunto aleatorio)
- Puntaje por pregunta y nota mínima de aprobación
- Mostrar resultados al terminar (nada / solo nota / nota + respuestas correctas)
- Modo seguro (ver sección 5) con umbral de infracciones permitidas y acción al superarlo (anular, autoenviar, o solo registrar y notificar al docente)

## 5. Modo seguro (anti-trampa)
Aplica Fullscreen API y detección de eventos. Ten en cuenta que un navegador web NO puede bloquear físicamente el cambio de ventana o pestaña, así que el objetivo es detectar, registrar y sancionar, no impedir. Documenta esta limitación honestamente en el README.
- Al iniciar el quiz, mostrar pantalla de instrucciones y un botón "Comenzar" que solicita pantalla completa (requiere gesto del usuario). Sin pantalla completa no se muestra ninguna pregunta.
- Detectar y registrar con marca de tiempo: salida de pantalla completa (`fullscreenchange`), cambio de pestaña (`visibilitychange`), pérdida de foco (`window blur`), intentos de abrir menú contextual, copiar/pegar/cortar, seleccionar texto, imprimir, atajos (F12, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+U, Alt+Tab no es detectable pero sí el blur resultante).
- Al detectar una infracción: pausar la visualización de la pregunta con un overlay de advertencia, exigir volver a pantalla completa para continuar, y sumar al contador de infracciones.
- Deshabilitar `user-select` y el menú contextual en el área del quiz.
- Persistir las infracciones en el servidor (tabla `ProctorEvent`) en tiempo real, no solo en el cliente.
- Advertir si el navegador no soporta Fullscreen API (ej. iPhone Safari) y bloquear el quiz en esos dispositivos si el modo seguro está activo.
- El docente ve un registro de infracciones por intento con la línea de tiempo.

## 6. Seguridad del lado servidor (crítico)
- Mostrar UNA pregunta por pantalla. El servidor entrega solo la pregunta actual; nunca envía todo el banco ni las respuestas correctas al cliente.
- Si el quiz es "sin retroceder", el servidor rechaza cualquier intento de modificar o consultar preguntas anteriores (no basta con ocultar el botón).
- El cronómetro se controla en el servidor (hora de inicio y fin guardadas); el cliente solo lo muestra. Al vencer, el intento se envía automáticamente.
- Cada intento tiene un estado (`en_progreso`, `enviado`, `anulado`) y no se puede reabrir tras enviarse.
- Evitar doble sesión simultánea del mismo estudiante en el mismo intento.
- Rate limiting en login y endpoints de respuesta; protección CSRF; cabeceras de seguridad (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.).
- El autoguardado de cada respuesta ocurre al avanzar, y el intento se puede reanudar si se cae la conexión (respetando el tiempo del servidor).
- Calificación siempre en el servidor.

## 7. Experiencia del estudiante
- Panel con quices disponibles, próximos y completados.
- Pantalla del quiz limpia: una pregunta, indicador de progreso (ej. 3/20), temporizador visible, botones "Siguiente" (y "Anterior" solo si está permitido), y confirmación antes de enviar.
- Revisión final opcional antes de enviar si se permite retroceder (lista de preguntas con estado respondida/sin responder).
- Diseño responsivo y accesible (contraste, foco visible, navegación por teclado).

## 8. Reportes (docente/admin)
- Resultados por quiz, grupo y estudiante: nota, tiempo, intentos, infracciones.
- Análisis por pregunta (porcentaje de aciertos, distractores más elegidos).
- Exportar a CSV/Excel.

## 9. Modelo de datos (mínimo)
User, Group, GroupMembership, Document, Question, QuestionOption, Quiz, QuizQuestion, QuizAssignment, Attempt, Answer, ProctorEvent, AuditLog.

## 10. Calidad
- Seed con datos de ejemplo (1 admin, 1 docente, 2 estudiantes, 1 quiz demo).
- Pruebas unitarias de la calificación y de las reglas de navegación, y pruebas e2e (Playwright) del flujo completo del estudiante, incluyendo que el servidor rechace retroceder en modo "sin retroceder".
- Manejo de errores claro (PDF corrupto o vacío, respuesta inválida del LLM, límite de tamaño de archivo configurable).
- Archivo `.env.example` y script `npm run dev`, `npm run seed`, `npm test`.

## 11. Orden de entrega
Fase 1: base del proyecto, auth y roles. Fase 2: carga de PDFs, extracción y generación/importación de preguntas con pantalla de revisión. Fase 3: configuración y publicación de quices. Fase 4: motor de aplicación del quiz (una pregunta por pantalla, navegación configurable, temporizador servidor). Fase 5: modo seguro con pantalla completa y registro de eventos. Fase 6: reportes y exportación. Fase 7: pruebas, endurecimiento de seguridad y README.

Antes de empezar, resume en 10 líneas el plan y las decisiones técnicas que tomarás, y luego comienza con la Fase 1 sin esperar confirmación.

Let me think about the architecture concretely so the code is coherent.

### Stack
- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4? Tailwind v4 with @tailwindcss/postcss. Might be simpler to use Tailwind v3 for stability. Actually `create-next-app` latest gives Tailwind v4. Let's check what gets installed. I'd rather scaffold manually with pinned versions to avoid surprises... but network install is needed anyway.

Plan: use `npx create-next-app@latest` with flags? That might be heavy but reliable. Alternatively write package.json manually and `npm install`. Manual gives control. Let's do manual `npm install next react react-dom typescript @types/...  tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer` pinned.

Let me pin:
- next ^15.x (App Router stable)
- react 19
- tailwindcss ^3.4 (stable, well-known config) — safer with our own config.
- prisma & @prisma/client ^6
- zod ^3
- bcryptjs + @types/bcryptjs
- pdf-parse? PDF parsing: `pdf-parse` is common but has issues in Next bundling (it reads test files at import). Better: `pdfjs-dist` legacy build, used server-side. Or `pdf-parse` v1.1.1 works with dynamic require. Hmm. For robustness, I'll use `pdfjs-dist` legacy build in a node runtime route. Actually pdfjs-dist v4 requires DOMMatrix etc for some paths; legacy build works in Node. Let me use `pdfjs-dist@4` legacy build `pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs`. It works in Node 18+ with some warnings. Canvas not needed for text extraction. Yes: getDocument({data, useSystemFonts:false, standardFontDataUrl}) then for each page getTextContent. That works.

Actually `pdf-parse` is simpler: `const pdfParse = require('pdf-parse')` — it has a debug mode that reads `./test/data/05-versions-space.pdf` only when `!module.parent`. In ESM import it may break. Known issue. I'll use pdfjs-dist legacy.

- tesseract.js optional OCR.
- LLM providers: Anthropic Messages API via fetch, OpenAI Chat Completions via fetch. No SDK needed → fewer deps. Good: abstraction `LLMProvider` interface with `generateJSON`.
- chalk? no.

Testing: vitest for unit tests (fast), Playwright for e2e. `npm test` runs vitest.

### Data model (Prisma)
User(id, email, name, passwordHash, role: ADMIN|TEACHER|STUDENT, active, createdAt)
Group(id, name, grade, year, createdById)
GroupMembership(id, userId, groupId, role? ) unique(userId, groupId)
Document(id, title, filename, mimeType, sizeBytes, textContent, pageCount, uploadedById, createdAt) — store extracted text; store file on disk under ./storage/uploads
Question(id, documentId?, authorId, type, statement, explanation, topic, sourcePage, difficulty, points? (points per quiz in QuizQuestion instead), status, options JSON? ) — better: QuestionOption table.
QuestionOption(id, questionId, label(A/B/C..), text, isCorrect, order)
Quiz(id, title, description, authorId, status DRAFT|PUBLISHED|CLOSED, navigationMode FORWARD_ONLY|FREE, showResults NONE|SCORE|SCORE_AND_ANSWERS, shuffleQuestions, shuffleOptions, maxAttempts, questionCount (subconjunto), timeLimitSec, perQuestionTimeSec, passingScore, secureMode, infractionThreshold, infractionAction, availableFrom, availableTo, createdAt)
QuizQuestion(id, quizId, questionId, order, points) unique(quizId, questionId)
QuizAssignment(id, quizId, groupId) unique
Attempt(id, quizId, studentId, attemptNumber, status IN_PROGRESS|SUBMITTED|VOIDED, startedAt, expiresAt, submittedAt, score, maxScore, currentIndex, questionOrder JSON, optionOrder JSON, lastSeenAt, unique(quizId, studentId, attemptNumber))
Answer(id, attemptId, questionId, selectedOptionIds JSON, textAnswer, isCorrect, pointsAwarded, answeredAt, timeSpentSec)
ProctorEvent(id, attemptId, type, detail, occurredAt, clientTs)
AuditLog(id, actorId, action, entity, entityId, meta, createdAt)

### Auth
- Cookie `qc_session` httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, secure in prod, contains session id; Session table? The spec's required tables are min 9 + AuditLog. I'll add Session table (fine, "mínimo"). Session(id, userId, token hash, expiresAt, createdAt, userAgent, ip).
- CSRF: double-submit cookie `qc_csrf` (readable from JS) + header `x-csrf-token` on mutations. Since SameSite=Strict already, add CSRF token for defense in depth.
- Rate limiting: in-memory limiter (documented) keyed by ip+route.

### Quiz engine
- Server endpoints:
  - POST /api/attempts/start {quizId}
  - GET /api/attempts/[id]/current → returns current question without correct answers
  - POST /api/attempts/[id]/answer {questionId, optionIds/text, clientTs}
  - POST /api/attempts/[id]/next / prev (or POST /api/attempts/[id]/move {dir}) enforcing forward-only
  - POST /api/attempts/[id]/submit
  - POST /api/attempts/[id]/proctor {type, detail, clientTs}
- Grading in server lib `grade.ts` pure functions → unit tested.
- Navigation rules in `lib/quiz/navigation.ts` pure → unit tested.

### Security headers
middleware.ts sets CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, etc.

## Plan (10 líneas)

1. **Base**: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript estricto + Tailwind CSS 3, estructura `src/app` (rutas UI) y `src/app/api` (API REST JSON) para que el motor del quiz tenga control 100% servidor.
2. **Datos**: Prisma + SQLite en dev, esquema portable a PostgreSQL (sin tipos nativos SQLite, JSON como `String`, IDs `cuid`), 15 modelos: User, Group, GroupMembership, Document, Question, QuestionOption, Quiz, QuizQuestion, QuizAssignment, Attempt, Answer, ProctorEvent, AuditLog (+ Session, RateLimit no persistente en memoria).
3. **Auth**: sesión opaca propia (token aleatorio hasheado en tabla `Session`), cookie `httpOnly` + `SameSite=Strict`, hashing `bcryptjs` (puro JS, evita binarios nativos de argon2 en Windows), CSRF double-submit y rate limiting en login.
4. **Fase 2**: extracción de texto con `pdfjs-dist` (legacy build, server-side) + OCR opcional `tesseract.js`; chunking con solape; capa `LLMProvider` (Anthropic/OpenAI vía `fetch`, sin SDK) que devuelve JSON estricto validado con Zod con 2 reintentos y deduplicación por similitud.
5. **Fase 3**: publicación de quiz con ventana de disponibilidad, navegación, tiempos, aleatorización, intentos, subconjunto, puntajes, visibilidad de resultados y modo seguro.
6. **Fase 4**: motor de intento — el servidor entrega **una sola** pregunta sin respuestas correctas, whitelist de avance estricta (`rechaza retroceder` a nivel de endpoint), autoguardado idempotente, reanudación y expiración por reloj de servidor.
7. **Fase 5**: modo seguro Fullscreen API + listeners (`fullscreenchange`, `visibilitychange`, `blur`, copy/paste, contextmenu, atajos), overlay de pausa, persistencia inmediata en `ProctorEvent` y bloqueo en navegadores sin Fullscreen API.
8. **Fase 6**: reportes de resultados, análisis por pregunta/distractores y export CSV/Excel (SpreadsheetML).
9. **Fase 7**: Vitest (calificación + reglas de navegación), Playwright e2e (flujo estudiante completo + rechazo de retroceso), headers de seguridad/CSP en middleware, y README honesto sobre límites del anti-trampa.
10. **Entrega por fases verificando en cada una** (`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`) antes de avanzar; `.env.example`, `npm run dev|seed|test` y documentación en español.

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// QuizColegio - Esquema de datos
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// NOTAS DE PORTABILIDAD SQLite -> PostgreSQL
//  * SQLite no soporta enums nativos en Prisma, por eso los campos de estado
//    y rol son `String` y se validan en la capa de aplicacion con Zod
//    (ver src/lib/dominio/constantes.ts). Para PostgreSQL se pueden migrar a
//    enums sin cambiar las columnas.
//  * Los campos JSON se guardan como `String` (JSON serializado) para que el
//    mismo esquema funcione en ambos motores. En PostgreSQL pueden pasar a
//    `Json` con un cambio minimo en los helpers de lectura/escritura.
//  * No se usan tipos nativos exclusivos de un motor.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite" // en produccion: "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Usuarios, sesiones y grupos
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model User {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  email        String   @unique
  name         String
  passwordHash String
  role         String // ADMIN | TEACHER | STUDENT
  active       Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime @updatedAt

  sessions     Session[]
  memberships  GroupMembership[]
  documents    Document[]
  questions    Question[]
  quizzes      Quiz[]
  attempts     Attempt[]
  auditLogs    AuditLog[]
  createdGroups Group[]  @relation("GroupCreator")

  @@index([role, active])
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  tokenHash    String   @unique
  csrfToken    String
  ip           String?
  userAgent    String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  lastSeenAt   DateTime @default(now())
  expiresAt    DateTime
  revokedAt    DateTime?

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Group {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  grade       String? // curso / nivel, ej "10A"
  year        Int
  description String?
  createdById String?
  active      Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  createdBy   User?             @relation("GroupCreator", fields: [createdById], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  memberships GroupMembership[]
  assignments QuizAssignment[]

  @@unique([name, year])
  @@index([year, active])
}

model GroupMembership {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  user  User  @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, groupId])
  @@index([groupId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Documentos y banco de preguntas
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Document {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  title         String
  originalName  String
  storagePath   String
  mimeType      String
  sizeBytes     Int
  pageCount     Int      @default(0)
  charCount     Int      @default(0)
  extractedText String   @default("") // texto completo extraido (o primer tramo si es enorme)
  status        String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING | EXTRACTED | EMPTY | FAILED | OCR_USED
  errorMessage  String?
  usedOcr       Boolean  @default(false)
  uploadedById  String
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  uploadedBy User       @relation(fields: [uploadedById], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  questions  Question[]

  @@index([uploadedById, createdAt])
}

model Question {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  type          String // MCQ_SINGLE | MCQ_MULTI | TRUE_FALSE | SHORT_ANSWER
  statement     String
  explanation   String?
  topic         String?
  sourcePage    Int?
  difficulty    String   @default("MEDIUM") // EASY | MEDIUM | HARD
  status        String   @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT | PENDING_REVIEW | APPROVED
  points        Float    @default(1)
  fingerprint   String? // hash normalizado del enunciado, para deduplicar
  origin        String   @default("MANUAL") // MANUAL | GENERATED | IMPORTED
  llmModel      String?
  answerPending Boolean  @default(false) // importado sin respuesta correcta detectable
  authorId      String
  documentId    String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  author   User             @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  document Document?        @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  options  QuestionOption[]
  quizzes  QuizQuestion[]

  @@index([authorId, createdAt])
  @@index([documentId])
  @@index([fingerprint])
}

model QuestionOption {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  questionId String
  label      String // A, B, C...
  text       String
  isCorrect  Boolean @default(false)
  position   Int

  question Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([questionId, position])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Quices
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Quiz {
  id          String  @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String?
  authorId    String
  status      String  @default("DRAFT") // DRAFT | PUBLISHED | CLOSED

  // Grupos -> via QuizAssignment

  // Ventana de disponibilidad
  availableFrom DateTime?
  availableTo   DateTime?

  // Navegacion: FORWARD_ONLY | FREE
  navigationMode String @default("FREE")

  // Tiempos (segundos, opcionales)
  timeLimitSec      Int?
  perQuestionTimeSec Int?

  // Aleatorizacion
  shuffleQuestions Boolean @default(false)
  shuffleOptions   Boolean @default(false)

  // Intentos y subconjunto
  maxAttempts   Int  @default(1)
  questionCount Int? // cuantas preguntas se toman del banco (null = todas)

  // Calificacion
  defaultPoints Float @default(1)
  passingScore  Float @default(3) // nota minima de aprobacion
  maxGrade      Float @default(5) // escala maxima de la nota
  showResults   String @default("SCORE") // NONE | SCORE | SCORE_AND_ANSWERS
  allowReview   Boolean @default(false) // revision final antes de enviar

  // Modo seguro
  secureMode          Boolean @default(false)
  infractionThreshold Int     @default(3)
  infractionAction    String  @default("AUTO_SUBMIT") // VOID | AUTO_SUBMIT | REGISTER_ONLY
  blockWithoutFullscreen Boolean @default(true)

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
  publishedAt DateTime?

  author      User             @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  questions   QuizQuestion[]
  assignments QuizAssignment[]
  attempts    Attempt[]

  @@index([authorId, status])
}

model QuizQuestion {
  id         String @id @default(cuid())
  quizId     String
  questionId String
  position   Int
  points     Float  @default(1)

  quiz     Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([quizId, questionId])
  @@index([quizId, position])
}

model QuizAssignment {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  quizId    String
  groupId   String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  quiz  Quiz  @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  group Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([quizId, groupId])
  @@index([groupId])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Intentos, respuestas y proctoring
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model Attempt {
  id            String  @id @default(cuid())
  quizId        String
  studentId     String
  attemptNumber Int
  status        String  @default("IN_PROGRESS") // IN_PROGRESS | SUBMITTED | VOIDED

  startedAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  expiresAt   DateTime?
  lastSeenAt  DateTime  @default(now())
  submittedAt DateTime?
  submitReason String? // MANUAL | TIME_UP | INFRACTIONS | FORCED

  currentPosition Int @default(0) // indice dentro del orden de preguntas
  questionOrder   String @default("[]") // JSON: [questionId, ...]
  optionOrder     String @default("{}") // JSON: { questionId: [optionId, ...] }

  score        Float? @default(0)
  maxScore     Float  @default(0)
  grade        Float?
  passed       Boolean?

  infractions  Int @default(0)
  voidedReason String?
  ip           String?
  userAgent    String?

  quiz    Quiz     @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  student User     @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  answers Answer[]
  events  ProctorEvent[]

  @@unique([quizId, studentId, attemptNumber])
  @@index([studentId, status])
  @@index([quizId, status])
}

model Answer {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  attemptId       String
  questionId      String
  selectedOptions String   @default("[]") // JSON: [optionId, ...]
  textAnswer      String?
  isCorrect       Boolean?
  pointsAwarded   Float    @default(0)
  timeSpentSec    Int      @default(0)
  isFinal         Boolean  @default(true) // false si quedo guardada pero no confirmada
  answeredAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt

  attempt  Attempt  @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question Question @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([attemptId, questionId])
  @@index([questionId])
}

model ProctorEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  attemptId  String
  type       String // FULLSCREEN_EXIT | TAB_HIDDEN | WINDOW_BLUR | CONTEXT_MENU | COPY | PASTE | CUT | PRINT | SHORTCUT | SELECTION | FOCUS_LOST | NO_FULLSCREEN_SUPPORT
  detail     String?
  severity   String   @default("WARNING") // INFO | WARNING | CRITICAL
  countsAsInfraction Boolean @default(true)
  clientTs   DateTime?
  occurredAt DateTime @default(now())
  ip         String?
  userAgent  String?

  attempt Attempt @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([attemptId, occurredAt])
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Auditoria y configuracion global
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  actorId    String?
  action     String // LOGIN_OK | LOGIN_FAIL | USER_CREATED | QUIZ_PUBLISHED | ...
  entityType String?
  entityId   String?
  meta       String? // JSON
  ip         String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  actor User? @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([action])
}

model Setting {
  key       String   @id
  value     String
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$jarEstudiante = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-estudiante-cookies.txt'
Remove-Item $jarAdmin, $jarDocente, $jarEstudiante -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$resultados = @()
function Anota($nombre, $ok, $detalle) {
  $script:resultados += [pscustomobject]@{ Prueba = $nombre; Ok = [bool]$ok; Detalle = $detalle }
}
function EscribeJson($ruta, $texto) {
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($ruta, $texto, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function LeerCookie($jar, $nombre) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $jar)) { return $null }
  foreach ($linea in Get-Content $jar) {
    $limpia = $linea -replace '^#HttpOnly_', ''
    if ($limpia.StartsWith('#') -or $limpia.Trim() -eq '') { continue }
    $partes = $limpia -split "`t"
    if ($partes.Count -ge 7 -and $partes[5] -eq $nombre) { return $partes[6] }
  }
  return $null
}
function Login($correo, $clave, $jar) {
  $cuerpo = Join-Path $tmp ('qc-login-' + ($correo -replace '[^a-z0-9]', '') + '.json')
  EscribeJson $cuerpo ("{""correo"":""$correo"",""contrasena"":""$clave""}")
  $cabeceras = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-login-headers.txt'
  $salida = curl.exe -s -D $cabeceras -c $jar -w "|%{http_code}" -X POST "$base/api/auth/login" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$cuerpo"
  return @{ estado = (($salida -split '\|')[-1]); cuerpo = (($salida -split '\|')[0]); cabeceras = (Get-Content $cabeceras -Raw) }
}
function Cuerpo($json) {
  $ruta = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-cuerpo-temporal.json'
  EscribeJson $ruta $json
  return $ruta
}

​## Objective
- Build "QuizColegio" from scratch: a Spanish-language school quiz management/app system (Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma/SQLite + own auth + PDF extraction + LLM question generation), delivered in 7 phases, each executed and tested before moving on, ending with a README.

## Requirements
- UI entirely in Spanish; work phase-by-phase, testing each before advancing.
- Stack: Next.js App Router, TS, Tailwind, Prisma+SQLite (PostgreSQL-portable schema), own user/password auth (argon2 or bcrypt), sessions in httpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie, Zod validation on all server input, pdfjs-dist/pdf-parse + optional OCR via tesseract.js, LLM provider abstraction (`LLMProvider`) configurable via `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY`, API key never reaches client.
- Roles: Administrador (users, groups, global config), Docente (documents, quizzes, results), Estudiante (take assigned quizzes).
- Quiz creation flow: upload PDF(s) → choose "generate from material" (count, types, difficulty, language) or "import existing exam/bank"; LLM returns strict Zod-validated JSON, retry up to 2 times; review screen (edit/delete/reorder/add); nothing published without review; chunking with progress bar and cross-chunk dedup.
- Per-quiz config: title, description, groups, availability window, navigation mode (forward-only vs free), total and/or per-question time, shuffle questions/options, max attempts, question subset, points/passing score, results visibility, secure mode with infraction threshold and action (void/auto-submit/register only).
- Secure mode: Fullscreen API + event detection, honest README limitation (browser cannot block tab switching), pause overlay on infraction, re-require fullscreen, disable user-select/context menu, persist to `ProctorEvent` server-side in real time, block on browsers without Fullscreen API (e.g., iPhone Safari) if secure mode is on, teacher sees infraction timeline.
- Server-side security (critical): one question per screen, server never sends whole bank or correct answers, server rejects backward navigation requests in forward-only mode, server-controlled timer with auto-submit, attempt states (`en_progreso`, `enviado`, `anulado`) not reopenable, prevent simultaneous double sessions, rate limiting on login/answer endpoints, CSRF protection, security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options), autosave-on-advance with resume after connection loss, grading always server-side.
- Student UX: panel with available/upcoming/completed quizzes, clean quiz screen with progress (3/20), timer, "Siguiente"/"Anterior" (only if allowed), confirm before submit, optional final review, responsive + accessible.
- Reports: results by quiz/group/student (grade, time, attempts, infractions), per-question analysis (success rate, common distractors), CSV/Excel export.
- Data model minimum: User, Group, GroupMembership, Document, Question, QuestionOption, Quiz, QuizQuestion, QuizAssignment, Attempt, Answer, ProctorEvent, AuditLog.
- Quality: seed (1 admin, 1 teacher, 2 students, 1 demo quiz), unit tests for grading and navigation rules, Playwright e2e of full student flow including server rejecting backward navigation, clear error handling (corrupt/empty PDF, invalid LLM response, configurable size limit), `.env.example`, scripts `npm run dev`, `npm run seed`, `npm test`.
- Before starting: summarize plan in 10 lines and begin Phase 1 without waiting for confirmation.

## Decisions
- `bcryptjs` (pure JS) instead of argon2 to avoid native Windows builds; cost from `BCRYPT_ROUNDS`.
- SQLite `String` columns for roles/status/JSON instead of Prisma enums (SQLite limitation); validated with Zod in `src/lib/dominio/constantes.ts`.
- Opaque session tokens: random token in `qc_session` cookie, sha256 hash stored in `Session` table; CSRF double-submit token in readable `qc_csrf` cookie + `x-csrf-token` header.
- API field names in Spanish (`correo`, `contrasena`, `nombre`, `grupos`, …); uniform envelope `{datos}` / `{error:{codigo,mensaje,campos}}`.
- LLM providers use `fetch` (no SDKs) with `LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic|openai|mock`; domain-level `LLMProvider` interface (`generarPreguntas`, `importarPreguntas`); a deterministic offline `mock` provider (cloze/true-false/multi generator + exam parser) for dev and e2e tests.
- Chunk-based generation via two endpoints (`/generar`, `/importar` per fragment index) so the client can render a real progress bar; each chunk API call is validated twice with Zod.
- In-memory rate limiter (documented as per-process limitation; Redis recommended for multi-instance).
- PDF extraction with `pdfjs-dist` legacy build; OCR path uses dynamic import of optional `@napi-rs/canvas` + `tesseract.js` with a clear fallback message when unavailable.
- Wrote minimal PDF generator (`crearPdfSimple`) for demo/seed/e2e instead of binary fixtures.
- `next.config.mjs` has `serverExternalPackages: ['pdfjs-dist','tesseract.js','@prisma/client']`; ESLint ignored during build.
- Root `/` redirects to `/panel` or `/login`; middleware only checks cookie presence, real authorization in server components/route handlers.
- Code avoids accented characters in source strings for consistency.

## Work State

function Anota($nombre, $ok, $detalle) {
  $script:resultados += [pscustomobject]@{ Prueba = $nombre; Ok = [bool]$ok; Detalle = $detalle }
}
function EscribeJson($ruta, $texto) {
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($ruta, $texto, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function LeerCookie($jar, $nombre) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $jar)) { return $null }
  foreach ($linea in Get-Content $jar) {
    $limpia = $linea -replace '^#HttpOnly_', ''
    if ($limpia.StartsWith('#') -or $limpia.Trim() -eq '') { continue }
    $partes = $limpia -split "`t"
    if ($partes.Count -ge 7 -and $partes[5] -eq $nombre) { return $partes[6] }
  }
  return $null
}
function Login($correo, $clave, $jar) {
  $cuerpo = Join-Path $tmp ('qc-f2-login-' + ($correo -replace '[^a-z0-9]', '') + '.json')
  EscribeJson $cuerpo ("{""correo"":""$correo"",""contrasena"":""$clave""}")
  $salida = (& curl.exe -s -c $jar -w "|%{http_code}" -X POST "$base/api/auth/login" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$cuerpo") -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Llamar($metodo, $url, $jar, $csrf, $cuerpo) {
  $argumentos = @('-s', '-b', $jar, '-w', '|%{http_code}', '-X', $metodo, $url)
  if ($csrf) { $argumentos += @('-H', "x-csrf-token: $csrf") }
  if ($cuerpo) { $argumentos += @('-H', 'Content-Type: application/json', '--data-binary', "@$cuerpo") }
  $salida = (& curl.exe @argumentos) -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Cuerpo($json) {
  $ruta = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f2-cuerpo.json'
  EscribeJson $ruta $json
  return $ruta
}

  $script:resultados += [pscustomobject]@{ Prueba = $nombre; Ok = [bool]$ok; Detalle = $detalle }
}
function EscribeJson($ruta, $texto) {
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($ruta, $texto, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function LeerCookie($jar, $nombre) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $jar)) { return $null }
  foreach ($linea in Get-Content $jar) {
    $limpia = $linea -replace '^#HttpOnly_', ''
    if ($limpia.StartsWith('#') -or $limpia.Trim() -eq '') { continue }
    $partes = $limpia -split "`t"
    if ($partes.Count -ge 7 -and $partes[5] -eq $nombre) { return $partes[6] }
  }
  return $null
}
function Login($correo, $clave, $jar) {
  $cuerpo = Join-Path $tmp ('qc-f3-login-' + ($correo -replace '[^a-z0-9]', '') + '.json')
  EscribeJson $cuerpo ("{""correo"":""$correo"",""contrasena"":""$clave""}")
  $salida = (& curl.exe -s -c $jar -w "|%{http_code}" -X POST "$base/api/auth/login" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$cuerpo") -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Llamar($metodo, $url, $jar, $csrf, $cuerpo) {
  $argumentos = @('-s', '-b', $jar, '-w', '|%{http_code}', '-X', $metodo, $url)
  if ($csrf) { $argumentos += @('-H', "x-csrf-token: $csrf") }
  if ($cuerpo) { $argumentos += @('-H', 'Content-Type: application/json', '--data-binary', "@$cuerpo") }
  $salida = (& curl.exe @argumentos) -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Cuerpo($json) {
  $ruta = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f3-cuerpo.json'
  EscribeJson $ruta $json
  return $ruta
}

Now Phase 4: quiz engine (student side): panel with available/upcoming/completed, quiz start, one question per screen, server timer, forward-only enforcement, autosave, submission, grading.

This is core and big. Let's plan carefully.

Phase 4 scope per original plan: "quiz engine (one question per screen, server timer, forward-only enforcement)". Secure mode Phase 5. But student UX + server security requirements span; implement engine now including server-side order, attempt states, autosave, timer, submission/grading. Secure mode events maybe Phase 5 but data model ready.

Key design decisions:

Student panel:
- `/estudiante/quices` lists quizzes assigned to student's groups (via QuizAssignment) that are PUBLISHED/CLOSED.
- Categorize:
  - Disponibles: PUBLISHED, now within [availableFrom, availableTo], attempts used < maxAttempts, no IN_PROGRESS? If IN_PROGRESS, show "Continuar".
  - Proximos: PUBLISHED with availableFrom > now; show date.
  - Completados/Cerrados: attempts submitted/voided or quiz CLOSED or window passed.
- Each card: title, description, groups? time, attempts (used/max), best grade, status, action "Presentar" / "Continuar" / "Ver resultado" (later Phase 6/7 results page? show basic result if showResults).
- For completed, show last attempt grade if allowed (not NONE).

Start attempt:
- POST /api/intentos {quizId}:
  - auth STUDENT
  - CSRF, rate limit (start too? requirement rate limiting on login/answer endpoints; implement answers + attempts).
  - quiz exists, PUBLISHED, within window, student in assigned group.
  - existing IN_PROGRESS attempt → return it (resume) instead of creating a second (prevents simultaneous double sessions; one active attempt per student/quiz).
  - count attempts (SUBMITTED/VOIDED) < maxAttempts.
  - build question order:
    - quiz questions; if questionCount < total, select subset randomly (deterministic? random each attempt).
    - if shuffleQuestions, shuffle.
    - option order per question: if shuffleOptions, shuffle option IDs; but SHORT_ANSWER single option no change.
  - attemptNumber = max existing + 1.
  - expiresAt = now + quiz.timeLimitSec (if set); if availableTo earlier, min.
  - questionOrder JSON, optionOrder JSON, currentPosition 0, maxScore sum of selected question points.
  - status IN_PROGRESS; ip/userAgent.
  - audit INTENTO_INICIADO.
  - return attempt id + maybe first question DTO.
- If existing IN_PROGRESS and not expired → return existing attempt (200) with `reanudado: true`. If expired → auto-submit with TIME_UP then return result? On start route: if expired, submit it and then allow new attempt? That consumes attempt. Better submit existing then respond `{intento: {...}, expirado: true}`? Simpler: finalize expired attempt via grading, then create new attempt if attempts remain. But auto-submit should happen server-side via any request. Implement `finalizarIntentoExpirado(attempt)` helper.

Fetch current question:
- GET /api/intentos/[id] → returns state: attempt metadata, question at currentPosition (one question, options in allowed order, no isCorrect), timer info expiresAt/serverNow, progress (pos+1/total), navigation mode, answered status, saved answer for current question, and flags canGoBack (FREE only), canGoForward.
- Server must not send whole bank or correct answers. Only current question.
- If attempt submitted/voided → return result summary or 409 ATTEMPO_CERRADO.
- If expired → auto-submit and return finalization info with 409? Better return attempt state with `finalizado: true` and redirect. For simplicity response 200 with `{finalizado:true, resultado: {...}}`.
- GET must also handle secure mode? no.

Answer + advance:
- POST /api/intentos/[id]/responder body {preguntaId, opciones: string[], texto?, tiempoSec?}:
  - auth student, owns attempt, IN_PROGRESS, not expired (if expired finalize).
  - rate limit per attempt/user (e.g. 30/min).
  - validate question is the current one (or previous if allow back? For answering current only). Requirement one question per screen; answer saved on advance.
  - validate option IDs belong to that question; option order irrelevant.
  - For SHORT_ANSWER: text trim max 500; grade by normalized equality with correct option text (case/accent-insensitive) later.
  - MCQ_SINGLE: exactly one option; TRUE_FALSE exactly one; MCQ_MULTI: 1..n.
  - Upsert Answer with selectedOptions JSON, textAnswer, isFinal, timeSpentSec, answeredAt.
  - Forward-only: after saving, currentPosition increments by 1. If last → do not auto-submit (student confirms submit) unless perQuestion timer? Keep final "revisar/enviar" screen.
  - For FREE mode: save answer but don't increment automatically? UI has "Guardar y siguiente" vs "Anterior". API should support action `avanzar: true` / navigate. Design body { ..., accion: 'GUARDAR'|'SIGUIENTE'|'ANTERIOR' }. For forward-only, only GUARDAR/SIGUIENTE (same). For FREE: SIGUIENTE increments, ANTERIOR decrements (server allows). Need reject ANTERIOR in forward-only with error code.
  - Also endpoint PATCH /api/intentos/[id]/posicion {posicion} for free navigation? Simpler single responder endpoint with accion. For "Anterior" without changing answer, still need endpoint. Add POST /api/intentos/[id]/navegar {direccion: 'ANTERIOR'|'SIGUIENTE', posicion?} with server enforcement; answer save separate endpoint.
  
  Better separation:
  - PUT /api/intentos/[id]/respuesta: save answer for current question only (autosave). Body {preguntaId, opciones, texto, tiempoSec}. No position change.
  - POST /api/intentos/[id]/avanzar: body {preguntaId?} increments currentPosition; forward-only enforced server-side; if last position → no change or returns final.
  - POST /api/intentos/[id]/retroceder: only if FREE; decrements; forward-only → 403/409.
  This gives clean security enforcement and autosave on advance: client saves then advances.
  - Server rejects answering a non-current question (in FREE mode, client navigates first then answers current). Good: one question per screen, answers only current.
  - In FREE mode, "Anterior" moves currentPosition; answers preserved. Student can revisit and change answer.
- Autosave: client debounce? We can save on option select immediately (debounced 400ms) and on advance await save. Requirement autosave-on-advance with resume. Implement immediate save on change with a small debounce, plus on advance. Avoid duplicate warnings. Timer runs client display based on server expiresAt; server authoritative.
- Per-question timer:
  - Store per-question deadline? Schema has no deadline per question. Could compute from attempt lastSeenAt? Requirement total and/or per-question time. Need server-side per-question timing. Options: use Answer.timeSpentSec and enforce at advance: if elapsed since question shown > perQuestionTime, auto-advance with saved answer? Server doesn't know when question shown. Could store in Attempt? Add field `questionStartedAt DateTime?` to schema. Add it (db push) to enforce per-question timer server-side. Or use `lastSeenAt` which updates on GET/answer; set lastSeenAt when navigating, and per-question deadline = lastSeenAt + perQuestionTime, reset on each question fetch; but GET polling could reset (cheat). Better new field `questionStartedAt` set only on advance/start/resume? Resume should not reset timer (would cheat by reload). Hmm: on connection loss, per-question elapsed should continue. Set questionStartedAt when position changes; on resume it stays. GET returns remaining. When expired: finalize/advance automatically? Server should auto-advance to next question or submit entire attempt? Spec says per-question time; likely when time runs out, move to next question (answer saved). Implement: on GET/responder/avanzar, if perQuestionTime and now - questionStartedAt > limit, auto-advance to next position (and if last, auto-submit TIME_UP). But auto-advance unsaved answers (autosave already saved on change). That is reasonable.
  - Add schema field `questionStartedAt DateTime?`.
  - Client timer per question: computes remaining from questionStartedAt + perQuestionTime (server provides `preguntaExpiraEn`). When 0 → calls /avanzar (or server GET will auto-advance). Client auto-calls next endpoint.
  - Total timer: expiresAt; when 0 → server auto-submits on any request; client calls /enviar {motivo?} or a heartbeat GET which auto-submits TIME_UP. Implement endpoint POST /api/intentos/[id]/tiempo? Simpler: client when total time 0 calls POST /entregar with `{automatico:true}` but server should reject if not actually expired; if expired, finalize with TIME_UP regardless. Better: GET current state detects expired and finalizes; client timer hits 0 → fetch state, receives finalizado. Also answer/advance calls enforce. There's a gap if client disconnects; reports can finalize on access. Acceptable; add `lastSeenAt` heartbeat? Implement a `GET` poll every 15s in client updates lastSeenAt; not essential.
  - Auto-submit stale attempts: helper `finalizarSiExpirado(intento)` used by endpoints. Also teacher reports can trigger later.

Submission:
- POST /api/intentos/[id]/entregar body {confirmado:true, motivo?}. Server:
  - if already SUBMITTED → idempotent return result.
  - if VOIDED → 409.
  - if expired → finalize TIME_UP.
  - grade all answers server-side: for each question in questionOrder, expected correct option IDs; compare sets for MCQ/TRUE_FALSE; SHORT_ANSWER normalize text vs correct options text (any). Points awarded if correct. isCorrect false if unanswered.
  - score sum, maxScore, grade = score/maxScore * maxGrade (rounded 2 decimals) (if maxScore 0 → 0), passed = grade >= passingScore.
  - status SUBMITTED, submittedAt, submitReason MANUAL.
  - audit INTENTO_ENVIADO.
  - response result based on showResults: NONE → {mostrar:'NONE'}; SCORE → score/grade/passed/total; SCORE_AND_ANSWERS → also per-question review with correct answers and student selections (only after submission, allowed).
- Attempt states not reopenable: all answer/advance endpoints reject if status !== IN_PROGRESS. Start creates new only if attempts remain.
- Prevent simultaneous double sessions: Start returns existing IN_PROGRESS rather than creating new. Additionally any start while active returns same attempt. Good.
- Attempt resume after connection loss: GET returns current state (current question, saved answer). Client on mount loads state and jumps to currentPosition. Add `/api/intentos/[id]`.
- Student panel "Continuar" links `/estudiante/quices/[id]/presentar`? Route structure:
  - `/estudiante/quices` panel
  - `/estudiante/quices/[quizId]` detail/start page (server checks eligibility, shows rules + "Comenzar"/"Continuar"; handles published, window, attempts).
  - `/estudiante/quices/[quizId]/presentar` client engine page; requires an active attempt? Server page can look up active attempt for student/quiz and redirect to `/estudiante/intentos/[id]`. Or make route attempt-based: `/estudiante/intentos/[attemptId]`. Start API returns attempt ID; client router.push(`/estudiante/intentos/${id}`). Panel resume links to attempt ID. Use `/estudiante/intentos/[id]/page.tsx` server checks ownership, renders client engine.
  - Need nav item? existing "Mis quices".
  - Maybe hide attempt URL leakage; server verifies ownership.

Results display: For Phase 4, engine shows result screen after submit per showResults. Also quiz detail page for completed attempts shows "Ver resultado" link? Could link to `/estudiante/intentos/[id]/resultado` page. Add result page server + client-ish static; respects visibility. Reports Phase 6 will add teacher. Student result page is useful.

API endpoints:
1. GET /api/estudiante/quices → panel data? Could do server page direct DB; no API needed. Panel server-rendered. But auto-refresh? fine.
2. POST /api/intentos → start/resume.
3. GET /api/intentos/[id] → state.
4. PUT /api/intentos/[id]/respuesta → save current answer.
5. POST /api/intentos/[id]/avanzar → advance.
6. POST /api/intentos/[id]/retroceder → free only.
7. POST /api/intentos/[id]/entregar → submit/grade.
8. Maybe POST /api/intentos/[id]/eventos (Phase 5).
9. GET result data included in attempt state after submit; result page server loads DB.

Schemas `src/lib/esquemas/intentos.ts`:
- esquemaIniciarIntento {quizId}
- esquemaRespuesta {preguntaId, opciones: string[] max 10 default [], texto: string max 1000 optional}
- esquemaAvanzar {} (no body) or {preguntaId}? body optional. Use no body.
- esquemaEntregar {confirmado: literal true}
- esquemaRetroceder {}.

Service `src/lib/intentos/servicio.ts`:
- helpers parse JSON arrays safely, obtenerIntentoAutorizado(id, studentId) include quiz, answers, events? 
- `estadoIntento(intento)` DTO.
- grading `calificarIntento(intento)` where intento includes quiz.questions with question.options.
- `finalizarIntento(intento, motivo)` transactional: compute grade from answers then update attempt; maybe accept current answers loaded.
- `finalizarSiExpirado(intento)` check expiresAt/perQuestion.
- `avanzarAutomatico(intento)`.
- `preguntaActual(intento, quiz)` uses questionOrder ids and quiz.questions map. Since questionOrder references question IDs; QuizQuestion points per question.
- Build DTO for current question with shuffled options from optionOrder JSON.
- Timer data: `expiraEn` (total), `preguntaExpiraEn`, serverNow.

Question content leakage: DTO includes only current question statement/options text, no isCorrect. Good.
- For true/false options, shuffle optionally but labels A/B generated dynamically? Option order array of IDs; return options with original label? Labels may be shuffled order; better reletter based on display order (A, B, C...) so labels match positions. Use display label index. Don't trust stored label. For SHORT_ANSWER, no options shown (maybe one option correct answer must not be sent). Return options: [] and `tipo: SHORT_ANSWER`, requiring text input. Yes: never send correct answer text. For short answer, question options include correct answer; if we sent it, leak. So for SHORT_ANSWER return `opciones: []`.
- MCQ_MULTI no partial credit (all-or-nothing) per simple grading.
- Answer save validation: option IDs must belong to question; for short answer text required? Allow blank (unanswered) to clear answer: if no options and no text → delete answer? Keep Answer with empty. On advance, unanswered allowed with confirmation? Student UX: warn if unanswered but allow. "confirm before submit" summary shows unanswered.
- Answer DTO for current question: selected option IDs in display order, text.

Server timer:
- expiresAt set start.
- `perQuestionTimeSec`: questionStartedAt.
- On `avanzar`, set questionStartedAt=now, currentPosition+1, lastSeenAt now.
- On `retroceder` (FREE), set questionStartedAt=now (new time on revisit) — reasonable.
- `finalizarSiExpirado`:
  - if expiresAt <= now → finalize TIME_UP.

messages.summary:
​## Objective
- Build "QuizColegio" from scratch: a Spanish-language school quiz management/app system (Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind + Prisma/SQLite + own auth + PDF extraction + LLM question generation), delivered in 7 phases, each executed and tested before moving on, ending with a README.

## Requirements
- UI entirely in Spanish; work phase-by-phase, testing each before advancing.
- Stack: Next.js App Router, TS, Tailwind, Prisma+SQLite (PostgreSQL-portable schema), own user/password auth (argon2 or bcrypt), sessions in httpOnly + SameSite=Strict cookie, Zod validation on all server input, pdfjs-dist/pdf-parse + optional OCR via tesseract.js, LLM provider abstraction (`LLMProvider`) configurable via `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`/`OPENAI_API_KEY`, API key never reaches client.
- Roles: Administrador (users, groups, global config), Docente (documents, quizzes, results), Estudiante (take assigned quizzes).
- Quiz creation flow: upload PDF(s) → choose "generate from material" (count, types, difficulty, language) or "import existing exam/bank"; LLM returns strict Zod-validated JSON, retry up to 2 times; review screen (edit/delete/reorder/add); nothing published without review; chunking with progress bar and cross-chunk dedup.
- Per-quiz config: title, description, groups, availability window, navigation mode (forward-only vs free), total and/or per-question time, shuffle questions/options, max attempts, question subset, points/passing score, results visibility, secure mode with infraction threshold and action (void/auto-submit/register only).
- Secure mode: Fullscreen API + event detection, honest README limitation (browser cannot block tab switching), pause overlay on infraction, re-require fullscreen, disable user-select/context menu, persist to `ProctorEvent` server-side in real time, block on browsers without Fullscreen API (e.g., iPhone Safari) if secure mode is on, teacher sees infraction timeline.
- Server-side security (critical): one question per screen, server never sends whole bank or correct answers, server rejects backward navigation requests in forward-only mode, server-controlled timer with auto-submit, attempt states (`en_progreso`, `enviado`, `anulado`) not reopenable, prevent simultaneous double sessions, rate limiting on login/answer endpoints, CSRF protection, security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options), autosave-on-advance with resume after connection loss, grading always server-side.
- Student UX: panel with available/upcoming/completed quizzes, clean quiz screen with progress (3/20), timer, "Siguiente"/"Anterior" (only if allowed), confirm before submit, optional final review, responsive + accessible.
- Reports: results by quiz/group/student (grade, time, attempts, infractions), per-question analysis (success rate, common distractors), CSV/Excel export.
- Data model minimum: User, Group, GroupMembership, Document, Question, QuestionOption, Quiz, QuizQuestion, QuizAssignment, Attempt, Answer, ProctorEvent, AuditLog.
- Quality: seed (1 admin, 1 teacher, 2 students, 1 demo quiz), unit tests for grading and navigation rules, Playwright e2e of full student flow including server rejecting backward navigation, clear error handling (corrupt/empty PDF, invalid LLM response, configurable size limit), `.env.example`, scripts `npm run dev`, `npm run seed`, `npm test`.
- Before starting: summarize plan in 10 lines and begin Phase 1 without waiting for confirmation.

## Decisions
- `bcryptjs` (pure JS) instead of argon2 to avoid native Windows builds; cost from `BCRYPT_ROUNDS`.
- SQLite `String` columns for roles/status/JSON instead of Prisma enums (SQLite limitation); validated with Zod in `src/lib/dominio/constantes.ts`.
- Opaque session tokens: random token in `qc_session` cookie, sha256 hash stored in `Session` table; CSRF double-submit token in readable `qc_csrf` cookie + `x-csrf-token` header.
- API field names in Spanish (`correo`, `contrasena`, `nombre`, `grupos`, …); uniform envelope `{datos}` / `{error:{codigo,mensaje,campos}}`.
- LLM providers use `fetch` (no SDKs) with `LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic|openai|mock`; domain-level `LLMProvider` interface (`generarPreguntas`, `importarPreguntas`); a deterministic offline `mock` provider for dev/e2e.
- Chunk-based generation via two endpoints (`/generar`, `/importar` per fragment index) so the client can render a real progress bar; each chunk API call is validated twice with Zod.
- In-memory rate limiter (documented as per-process limitation; Redis recommended for multi-instance).
- PDF extraction with `pdfjs-dist` legacy build; OCR path uses dynamic import of optional `@napi-rs/canvas` + `tesseract.js` with a clear fallback message when unavailable.
- Wrote minimal PDF generator (`crearPdfSimple`) for demo/seed/e2e instead of binary fixtures.
- `next.config.mjs` has `serverExternalPackages: ['pdfjs-dist','tesseract.js','@napi-rs/canvas','@prisma/client']`; ESLint ignored during build.
- Root `/` redirects to `/panel` or `/login`; middleware only checks cookie presence, real authorization in server components/route handlers.
- Code avoids accented characters in source strings for consistency.
- Quiz publication requires explicit `confirmoRevision: true`, at least one question/group, confirmed correct answers, valid future window, and `questionCount <= questions`; publishing marks included questions `APPROVED`/`answerPending=false`.
- Quiz questions are replaced atomically via a full ordered `PUT` list; editing questions blocked once attempts exist; closed quizzes are read-only and non-deletable (only drafts deletable).
- Attempt engine design: one `IN_PROGRESS` attempt per quiz/student (start returns/resumes it), frozen `questionOrder`/`optionOrder`, server-only current question, answers accepted only for current question, `FORWARD_ONLY` rejects `/retroceder`, grading all-or-nothing for MCQ/TRUE_FALSE and normalized text for SHORT_ANSWER.
- Added `Attempt.questionStartedAt` to enforce per-question time server-side; on expiry server auto-advances or auto-submits on last question; total time expiry auto-submits `TIME_UP`.
- Short-answer correct option text is never sent to the client; only the current question and its option texts are sent (no `isCorrect`).

## Work State
### Completed
- Phase 1 (base, auth, roles, admin modules, security headers, audit log, 24/24 smoke tests, clean typecheck).
- Phase 2 (documents, PDF extraction/OCR path, chunking, LLM layer, dedup, generation/import APIs, question bank CRUD/UI): verified 26/26 curl tests and zero browser console errors.
- Fixed Phase 2 bugs: `@napi-rs/canvas` bundling (added to `serverExternalPackages`), import pending-answer logic in `normalizarPreguntas`.
- Seed now writes a real 3-page demo PDF to `storage/uploads/demo-sistema-solar.pdf`, with `pagesJson`, `chunkCount`, size.
- Added "Banco de preguntas" nav item; typecheck clean.
- Phase 3 complete: quiz schemas/service, `/api/quices` list/create, `[id]` GET/PATCH/DELETE, `[id]/preguntas` PUT, `[id]/publicar`, `[id]/cerrar`; list page, editor with config/questions/review tabs, preview page; 24/24 curl tests passed; browser console clean; closed test quiz cleaned from DB.
- Phase 4 backend foundation: `Attempt.questionStartedAt` added and `prisma db push`/`generate` done; `src/lib/esquemas/intentos.ts` and `src/lib/intentos/servicio.ts` written (start/resume, state DTO, save validation support, server timer resolution, grading, result/summary DTOs, audit); client DTO types added. Typecheck not yet run on these new files.

### Active
- Phase 4: build API routes (`/api/intentos`, `[id]`, `respuesta`, `avanzar`, `retroceder`, `resumen`, `entregar`) and student UI (panel, quiz detail/rules, engine, result page), then test.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`; fix type errors in `src/lib/intentos/servicio.ts` and new DTO additions.
2. Add API routes under `src/app/api/intentos/**` with CSRF/auth/rate limiting and eligibility checks (published, assigned group, window, attempts, no duplicate in-progress).
3. Implement student pages: `/estudiante/quices` panel, `/estudiante/quices/[id]` rules/start/resume, `/estudiante/intentos/[id]` engine client, `/estudiante/intentos/[id]/resultado`.
4. Verify Phase 4 with a curl script: start/resume (same attempt), one-question payload/no `isCorrect`, answer save, forward-only `/retroceder` rejection, per-question/total expiry, submit/grading, no reopen, attempt limits, student ownership 403.
5. Browser-check student flow and console errors, then proceed to Phase 5 (secure mode/proctoring).

## Relevant Files
- `prisma/schema.prisma`: full data model; `Attempt.questionStartedAt` added.
- `src/lib/intentos/servicio.ts`: attempt engine core (DTOs, timers, grading, start/resume) — new, untested.
- `src/lib/esquemas/intentos.ts`: Zod schemas for start/answer/submit.
- `src/lib/cliente/tipos.ts`: shared DTO types incl. quiz/attempt/result types.
- `src/lib/quices/servicio.ts`: quiz includes, DTOs, publication validation.
- `src/app/api/quices/**`: Phase 3 quiz APIs (working).
- `src/app/(privado)/docentes/quices/**`: list, editor, preview UI (working).
- `src/lib/llm/tipos.ts`: normalization fixed for imported exams with null distractors.
- `prisma/seed.ts`: demo users/groups/quiz + real demo PDF.
- `next.config.mjs`: external packages incl. `@napi-rs/canvas`.
- `src/lib/http.ts`, `src/lib/auth/guard.ts`, `src/lib/rate-limit.ts`, `src/lib/audit.ts`: shared server infrastructure.
- `C:\Users\joan\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\fase2-pruebas.ps1` and `fase3-pruebas.ps1`: working curl test-script patterns.
- `C:\Users\joan\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\examen-prueba.pdf`: import test fixture.

## Important Context
- Shell is Windows PowerShell 5.1: no `-SkipHttpErrorCheck`, no `ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable`; use `curl.exe` with cookie jars; `$env:TEMP` is `C:\Users\joan\AppData\Local\Temp` (not `...\Temp\opencode`).
- PowerShell function calls without parentheses bind only the first string; build JSON in a variable before calling `Cuerpo`.
- `prisma generate` fails with EPERM while `next dev` holds the query-engine DLL — stop the dev server first.
- Dev server currently NOT running (stopped for schema push/generate); restart with `npm run dev` before testing.
- Seed credentials: `admin@colegio.edu / Admin123!`, `docente@colegio.edu / Docente123!`, `estudiante1..3@colegio.edu / Estudiante123!`; group "Decimo A"; one published demo quiz assigned to it.
- Browser tooling: use `http://127.0.0.1:3000` (localhost tab has a stale cookie causing redirect loop); `browser.evaluate` parameter is `script`; login via `fetch('/api/auth/login',...)`; console via `browser.console`; clicks/screenshots may fail without visible desktop.
- Phase 3 test script left no test quizzes; the demo quiz remains published with 5 approved questions.
- Phases 5–7 remain: secure mode/proctoring UI + events, reports/exports, tests (Vitest + Playwright) and README.

# Pruebas de humo de la Fase 4: motor de intentos del estudiante
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$base = 'http://127.0.0.1:3000'
$tmp = $env:TEMP
$jarDocente = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-docente.txt'
$jarEst1 = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-est1.txt'
$jarEst2 = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-est2.txt'
$jarEst3 = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-est3.txt'
Remove-Item $jarDocente, $jarEst1, $jarEst2, $jarEst3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$resultados = @()
function Anota($nombre, $ok, $detalle) {
  $script:resultados += [pscustomobject]@{ Prueba = $nombre; Ok = [bool]$ok; Detalle = $detalle }
}
function EscribeJson($ruta, $texto) {
  [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($ruta, $texto, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
}
function LeerCookie($jar, $nombre) {
  if (-not (Test-Path $jar)) { return $null }
  foreach ($linea in Get-Content $jar) {
    $limpia = $linea -replace '^#HttpOnly_', ''
    if ($limpia.StartsWith('#') -or $limpia.Trim() -eq '') { continue }
    $partes = $limpia -split "`t"
    if ($partes.Count -ge 7 -and $partes[5] -eq $nombre) { return $partes[6] }
  }
  return $null
}
function Login($correo, $clave, $jar) {
  $cuerpo = Join-Path $tmp ('qc-f4-login-' + ($correo -replace '[^a-z0-9]', '') + '.json')
  EscribeJson $cuerpo ("{""correo"":""$correo"",""contrasena"":""$clave""}")
  $salida = (& curl.exe -s -c $jar -w "|%{http_code}" -X POST "$base/api/auth/login" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$cuerpo") -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Llamar($metodo, $url, $jar, $csrf, $cuerpo) {
  $argumentos = @('-s', '-b', $jar, '-w', '|%{http_code}', '-X', $metodo, $url)
  if ($csrf) { $argumentos += @('-H', "x-csrf-token: $csrf") }
  if ($cuerpo) { $argumentos += @('-H', 'Content-Type: application/json', '--data-binary', "@$cuerpo") }
  $salida = (& curl.exe @argumentos) -join "`n"
  $i = $salida.LastIndexOf('|')
  return @{ estado = $salida.Substring($i + 1); cuerpo = $salida.Substring(0, $i) }
}
function Cuerpo($json) {
  $ruta = Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-cuerpo.json'
  EscribeJson $ruta $json
  return $ruta
}
function Datos($cuerpo) { return ($cuerpo | ConvertFrom-Json).datos }

# --- Sesiones --------------------------------------------------------------
$r = Login 'docente@colegio.edu' 'Docente123!' $jarDocente
$csrfDoc = LeerCookie $jarDocente 'qc_csrf'
Anota 'Login del docente' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $csrfDoc) "status=$($r.estado)"
Login 'estudiante1@colegio.edu' 'Estudiante123!' $jarEst1 | Out-Null
$csrf1 = LeerCookie $jarEst1 'qc_csrf'
Login 'estudiante2@colegio.edu' 'Estudiante123!' $jarEst2 | Out-Null
$csrf2 = LeerCookie $jarEst2 'qc_csrf'
Login 'estudiante3@colegio.edu' 'Estudiante123!' $jarEst3 | Out-Null
$csrf3 = LeerCookie $jarEst3 'qc_csrf'
Anota 'Sesiones de estudiantes iniciadas' ($csrf1 -and $csrf2 -and $csrf3)

# --- Datos base: quiz demo y mapa de respuestas correctas ------------------
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/quices" $jarDocente $null $null
$lista = (Datos $r.cuerpo).quices
$demo = $lista | Where-Object { $_.titulo -like '*sistema solar*' } | Select-Object -First 1
$demoId = $demo.id
Anota 'Quiz demo localizado (publicado, 5 preguntas)' ($demo -and $demo.estado -eq 'PUBLISHED' -and $demo.totalPreguntas -eq 5) "id=$demoId"

$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/quices/$demoId" $jarDocente $null $null
$detalle = (Datos $r.cuerpo).quiz
$mapa = @{}
foreach ($p in $detalle.preguntas) {
  $mapa[$p.preguntaId] = @($p.opciones | Where-Object { $_.correcta } | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
}
Anota 'Mapa de respuestas correctas construido (docente)' ($mapa.Count -eq 5) "preguntas=$($mapa.Count)"

# --- Panel y ficha del estudiante ------------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/estudiante/quices" $jarEst1 $null $null
Anota 'Panel /estudiante/quices lista el quiz demo' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'sistema solar') "status=$($r.estado)"
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/estudiante/quices/$demoId" $jarEst1 $null $null
Anota 'Ficha del quiz muestra las reglas (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'Reglas del quiz') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- Inicio, reanudacion y payload seguro ----------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$demoId""}"))
$inicio = Datos $r.cuerpo
$i1 = $inicio.estado.id
Anota 'Iniciar intento (201, en progreso, 5 preguntas)' ($r.estado -eq '201' -and $inicio.estado.estado -eq 'IN_PROGRESS' -and $inicio.estado.total -eq 5 -and $inicio.estado.pregunta) "status=$($r.estado) total=$($inicio.estado.total)"
Anota 'El estado no expone la respuesta correcta' ($r.cuerpo -notmatch 'isCorrect' -and $r.cuerpo -notmatch '"correcta"' -and $inicio.estado.pregunta.opciones.Count -gt 0) "opciones=$($inicio.estado.pregunta.opciones.Count)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$demoId""}"))
$reanudado = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Reanudar devuelve el mismo intento (sin duplicar)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $reanudado.reanudado -and $reanudado.estado.id -eq $i1) "status=$($r.estado) id=$($reanudado.estado.id)"

# Guardar respuesta para una pregunta que no es la vigente
$otraPregunta = ($detalle.preguntas | Where-Object { $_.preguntaId -ne $inicio.estado.pregunta.id } | Select-Object -First 1).preguntaId
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/respuesta" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo ("{""preguntaId"":""$otraPregunta"",""opciones"":[],""texto"":null}"))
Anota 'Responder una pregunta fuera de turno se rechaza (409)' ($r.estado -eq '409' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'PREGUNTA_FUERA_DE_TURNO') "status=$($r.estado)"

# Guardar la respuesta correcta de la pregunta vigente
$pidActual = $inicio.estado.pregunta.id
if ($inicio.estado.pregunta.tipo -eq 'SHORT_ANSWER') {
  $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $pidActual; opciones = @(); texto = 'Sol' } | ConvertTo-Json
} else {
  $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $pidActual; opciones = @($mapa[$pidActual]); texto = $null } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
}
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/respuesta" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo $cuerpoResp)
$guardado = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Guardar respuesta vigente (200, guardada)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $guardado.guardada -and $guardado.estado.respondidas -eq 1) "status=$($r.estado) respondidas=$($guardado.estado.respondidas)"

# Respuesta de seleccion unica limitada a una opcion
if ($inicio.estado.pregunta.tipo -eq 'MCQ_SINGLE') {
  $dosOpciones = @($inicio.estado.pregunta.opciones | Select-Object -First 2 | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
  $cuerpoDoble = @{ preguntaId = $pidActual; opciones = $dosOpciones; texto = $null } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
  $r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/respuesta" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo $cuerpoDoble)
  $soloUna = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado.pregunta.respuesta.opciones.Count
  Anota 'Pregunta de respuesta unica guarda solo una opcion' ($soloUna -eq 1) "opciones=$soloUna"
}

# --- Navegacion en modo libre ----------------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/avanzar" $jarEst1 $csrf1 $null
$trasAvanzar = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Avanzar a la pregunta 2 (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $trasAvanzar.estado.posicion -eq 1) "status=$($r.estado) posicion=$($trasAvanzar.estado.posicion)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/retroceder" $jarEst1 $csrf1 $null
$trasRetro = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Retroceder en modo libre (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $trasRetro.estado.posicion -eq 0) "status=$($r.estado) posicion=$($trasRetro.estado.posicion)"

$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$i1/resumen" $jarEst1 $null $null
$resumen = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Resumen previo al envio (200, total 5)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $resumen.resumen.total -eq 5) "status=$($r.estado) total=$($resumen.resumen.total)"

# --- Propiedad del intento -------------------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$i1" $jarEst2 $null $null
Anota 'Otro estudiante no puede ver un intento ajeno (403)' ($r.estado -eq '403') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- CSRF ------------------------------------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst1 $null (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$demoId""}"))
Anota 'Sin token CSRF el inicio se rechaza (403)' ($r.estado -eq '403' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'CSRF') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- Elegibilidad por grupo ------------------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst3 $csrf3 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$demoId""}"))
Anota 'Estudiante de otro grupo no puede presentarlo (403)' ($r.estado -eq '403' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'QUIZ_NO_ASIGNADO') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- Intento completo calificado (estudiante 2) ----------------------------
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$demoId""}"))
$estado = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado
$i2 = $estado.id
$okCalifica = $true
for ($paso = 0; $paso -lt 5; $paso++) {
  $p = $estado.pregunta
  if (-not $p) { $okCalifica = $false; break }
  if ($p.tipo -eq 'SHORT_ANSWER') {
    $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $p.id; opciones = @(); texto = 'Sol' } | ConvertTo-Json
  } else {
    $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $p.id; opciones = @($mapa[$p.id]); texto = $null } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
  }
  $r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i2/respuesta" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo $cuerpoResp)
  $estado = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado
  if (-not $estado.esUltima) {
    $r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i2/avanzar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 $null
    $estado = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado
  }
}

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i2/entregar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo '{"confirmado":true}')
$final = Datos $r.cuerpo
Anota 'Enviar el intento lo marca como SUBMITTED' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $final.estado.estado -eq 'SUBMITTED' -and $final.estado.segundosRestantes -eq $null) "status=$($r.estado) estado=$($final.estado.estado)"
Anota 'Calificacion perfecta calculada en el servidor (5/5, nota 5)' ($final.resultado.puntaje -eq 5 -and $final.resultado.puntajeMaximo -eq 5 -and $final.resultado.nota -eq 5 -and $final.resultado.aprobada) "puntaje=$($final.resultado.puntaje) nota=$($final.resultado.nota)"
$todasBien = @($final.resultado.preguntas | Where-Object { -not $_.correcta }).Count -eq 0
Anota 'Todas las preguntas quedaron correctas' ($todasBien -and $final.resultado.preguntas.Count -eq 5) "correctas=$(@($final.resultado.preguntas | Where-Object { $_.correcta }).Count)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i2/respuesta" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo (ConvertTo-Json @{ preguntaId = $pidActual; opciones = @(); texto = 'x' }))
Anota 'Un intento enviado no admite mas respuestas (409)' ($r.estado -eq '409') "status=$($r.estado)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$i2/entregar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo '{"confirmado":true}')
Anota 'Reenviar un intento enviado es idempotente (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado.estado -eq 'SUBMITTED') "status=$($r.estado)"

# La pagina de resultado se puede abrir y muestra el detalle
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/estudiante/intentos/$i2/resultado" $jarEst2 $null $null
Anota 'Pagina de resultado muestra el detalle (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'Detalle de tus respuestas') "status=$($r.estado)"

# El motor redirige a resultado si se abre un intento ya enviado
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/estudiante/intentos/$i2" $jarEst2 $null $null
Anota 'Abrir un intento enviado redirige al resultado' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'Detalle de tus respuestas') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- Edicion del banco con intentos ---------------------------------------
$r = Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/quices/$demoId" $jarDocente $null $null
Anota 'El docente ve los intentos registrados del quiz' ((Datos $r.cuerpo).quiz.intentos -ge 1) "intentos=$((Datos $r.cuerpo).quiz.intentos)"

Write-Host ''
Write-Host '--- Parte 2: quizzes creados por las pruebas ---'

# --- Quiz solo hacia adelante (maxIntentos 1) ------------------------------
function CrearQuizPublicado($titulo, $config) {
  $r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/quices" $jarDocente $csrfDoc (Cuerpo (ConvertTo-Json @{ titulo = $titulo; descripcion = 'Quiz creado por las pruebas de la fase 4.' }))
  $id = (Datos $r.cuerpo).quiz.id
  $config['titulo'] = $titulo
  $r = Llamar 'PATCH' "$base/api/quices/$id" $jarDocente $csrfDoc (Cuerpo ($config | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5))
  $idsBanco = @((Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/preguntas" $jarDocente $null $null).cuerpo).preguntas | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { $_.id })
  $r = Llamar 'PUT' "$base/api/quices/$id/preguntas" $jarDocente $csrfDoc (Cuerpo (ConvertTo-Json @{ preguntas = @($idsBanco | ForEach-Object { @{ id = $_; puntos = 1 } }) } -Depth 5))
  $r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/quices/$id/publicar" $jarDocente $csrfDoc (Cuerpo '{"confirmoRevision":true}')
  return @{ id = $id; estado = $r.estado; preguntas = $idsBanco }
}

$grupoId = ((Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/admin/grupos" $jarDocente $null $null).cuerpo).grupos | Where-Object { $_.nombre -eq 'Decimo A' } | Select-Object -First 1).id
$hasta = (Get-Date).AddDays(5).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ')

$cfgAdelante = @{
  grupoIds = @($grupoId); fechaDisponibleHasta = $hasta; navegacion = 'FORWARD_ONLY'
  tiempoTotalSeg = 600; intentosMaximos = 1; mostrarResultados = 'SCORE_AND_ANSWERS'
  permitirRevision = $false; modoSeguro = $false
}
$adelante = CrearQuizPublicado 'Quiz fase4 solo adelante' $cfgAdelante
Anota 'Quiz solo hacia adelante publicado' ($adelante.estado -eq '200') "status=$($adelante.estado)"
$aId = $adelante.id

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$aId""}"))
$estadoA = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado
$iaId = $estadoA.id
Anota 'Iniciar quiz solo hacia adelante (201)' ($r.estado -eq '201' -and $estadoA.navegacion -eq 'FORWARD_ONLY' -and -not $estadoA.puedeRetroceder) "status=$($r.estado)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId/avanzar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 $null
Anota 'Avanzar en solo hacia adelante (200, posicion 1)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado.posicion -eq 1) "status=$($r.estado)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId/retroceder" $jarEst2 $csrf2 $null
Anota 'Retroceder se rechaza en solo hacia adelante (409)' ($r.estado -eq '409' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'RETROCESO_NO_PERMITIDO') "status=$($r.estado)"

# Agotar el intento (3 preguntas) y verificar el limite de intentos
$estadoA = (Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId" $jarEst2 $null $null).cuerpo).estado
for ($paso = 0; $paso -lt 3; $paso++) {
  $p = $estadoA.pregunta
  if ($p.tipo -eq 'SHORT_ANSWER') { $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $p.id; opciones = @(); texto = 'Sol' } | ConvertTo-Json }
  else { $cuerpoResp = @{ preguntaId = $p.id; opciones = @($mapa[$p.id]); texto = $null } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 }
  Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId/respuesta" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo $cuerpoResp) | Out-Null
  if ($paso -lt 2) { $estadoA = (Datos (Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId/avanzar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 $null).cuerpo).estado }
}
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos/$iaId/entregar" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo '{"confirmado":true}')
Anota 'Enviar el quiz solo hacia adelante (200)' ($r.estado -eq '200' -and (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado.estado -eq 'SUBMITTED') "status=$($r.estado)"

$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst2 $csrf2 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$aId""}"))
Anota 'Sin intentos restantes no se puede reiniciar (409)' ($r.estado -eq '409' -and $r.cuerpo -match 'SIN_INTENTOS') "status=$($r.estado)"

# --- Temporizador por pregunta del servidor --------------------------------
$cfgTiempo = @{
  grupoIds = @($grupoId); fechaDisponibleHasta = $hasta; navegacion = 'FORWARD_ONLY'
  tiempoPorPreguntaSeg = 5; intentosMaximos = 1; mostrarResultados = 'SCORE'
  permitirRevision = $false; modoSeguro = $false
}
$tiempo = CrearQuizPublicado 'Quiz fase4 tiempo por pregunta' $cfgTiempo
$tId = $tiempo.id
$r = Llamar 'POST' "$base/api/intentos" $jarEst1 $csrf1 (Cuerpo ("{""quizId"":""$tId""}"))
$estadoT = (Datos $r.cuerpo).estado
$itId = $estadoT.id
Anota 'Iniciar quiz con tiempo por pregunta (201, ~5s)' ($r.estado -eq '201' -and $estadoT.segundosPreguntaRestantes -le 5 -and $estadoT.posicion -eq 0) "restantes=$($estadoT.segundosPreguntaRestantes)"

Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
$estadoT = (Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$itId" $jarEst1 $null $null).cuerpo).estado
Anota 'El servidor avanza solo al agotarse el tiempo de la pregunta (posicion 1)' ($estadoT.estado -eq 'IN_PROGRESS' -and $estadoT.posicion -eq 1) "estado=$($estadoT.estado) posicion=$($estadoT.posicion)"

Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
$estadoT = (Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$itId" $jarEst1 $null $null).cuerpo).estado
Anota 'Sigue avanzando al agotarse el tiempo (posicion 2)' ($estadoT.estado -eq 'IN_PROGRESS' -and $estadoT.posicion -eq 2) "estado=$($estadoT.estado) posicion=$($estadoT.posicion)"

Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
$estadoT = (Datos (Llamar 'GET' "$base/api/intentos/$itId" $jarEst1 $null $null).cuerpo).estado
Anota 'Tras la ultima pregunta el intento se envia solo (SUBMITTED)' ($estadoT.estado -eq 'SUBMITTED') "estado=$($estadoT.estado)"

# Guarda ids para limpieza posterior.
EscribeJson (Join-Path $tmp 'qc-f4-ids.txt') ("$demoId`n$aId`n$tId")

foreach ($fila in $resultados) {
  if ($fila.Ok) { Write-Host ("  [OK]    " + $fila.Prueba) }
  else { Write-Host ("  [FALLO] " + $fila.Prueba + "  -> " + $fila.Detalle) }
}
$fallos = @($resultados | Where-Object { -not $_.Ok }).Count
Write-Host ''
Write-Host ("RESULTADO: " + ($resultados.Count - $fallos) + "/" + $resultados.Count + " pruebas correctas")
if ($fallos -gt 0) { exit 1 }
